title: Four-cylinder engine crankshaft
author: devkrsm on Sketchfab
note: The crankshaft extracted from devkrsm's four-cylinder engine CAD model. Engine rpm measures this shaft's rotation, shown in an oblique inspection view so its journals remain visible beyond the end flange. Clockwise projected motion is a display convention for this unsigned speed. Pistons, connecting rods and the engine block are omitted; their reciprocating motion and combustion are not simulated. The counterweights and journals rotate as one rigid assembly. The displayed rate comes from the dataset, not a rated speed for this particular model.

steps: Downloaded CC-BY Sketchfab GLB; retained Crank Shaft:1_4 subtree with scripts/extract_glb_node.py.
glTF Transform 4.5.0 prune removed unused piston, connecting rod and material buffers; no new geometry, textures or decoder extensions.
